svg.text: MATL: Al 1100-H14 or 6063-T5. Skived, folded or bonded fin.
Base flatness 0.03. Ra 0.8 max on the TIM face.
Anodise 5 um clear, or bare + passivate. No paint.
Fit ONE configuration only — alternates, not stackable.
Relief pocket clears the folded pinch-off tube. 0.5 min clearance after pinch.
Fin tips deburred. No swarf — it migrates into the fin field.
AIRFLOW: CONFIG A channels run parallel to the 68 mm edge. Duct the fan so all 42 channels are fed;
a partially blocked inlet starves the downstream half and the die runs 15-20 K hotter than this table predicts.
SELECTION TABLE — 1.5 mm PITCH IS FORCED-AIR ONLY
optimum plate spacing, H=20, dT=40 K
A 1.1 mm gap 20 mm tall chokes buoyant flow: h collapses to 0.25 W/m2K. Never fit VC-201 in a fanless enclosure.
Al 1100-H14 / SKIVED OR BONDED / 68 x 68 x 22
